run: hyprctl eval 'hl.monitor({ output = "Virtual-1", mode = "1920x1080@60", position = "0x0", scale = 1 })'
qs ipc call experience set everyday

cat > "$HOME/qa-populate.sh" <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
# Real content behind the bars: terminals with output, a file manager and a browser-like window when installed.
# QA captures need windows visible side by side: the product default is the scrolling layout (columns scroll off-screen).
hyprctl eval 'hl.config({ general = { layout = "dwindle" } })' >/dev/null
run() { hyprctl eval "hl.exec_cmd(\"$1\")" >/dev/null; }
run "kitty --title QA-Terminal sh -c 'ls --color=always -la /usr/share/hornero | head -30; echo; df -h | head -8; exec sh'"
sleep 1
run "kitty --title QA-Monitor sh -c 'top -b -d 2 | head -40; exec sh'"
sleep 1
for fm in thunar nautilus pcmanfm dolphin; do command -v $fm >/dev/null && { run "$fm /usr/share/hornero"; break; }; done
for br in firefox chromium epiphany falkon; do command -v $br >/dev/null && { run "$br --new-window file:///usr/share/doc"; break; }; done
sleep 6
hyprctl clients -j | jq -r '.[].class' | sort | uniq -c > "$HOME/qa-clients.txt"
EOS
sh "$HOME/qa-populate.sh"
